body:
📦 **ArtGallery `8f52d17`** — fix(artgallery): repair legacy image path and add audit report

Move the remaining detective artwork into ArtGallery/RawImages and update its
exhibit card to use a repository-relative path. Add a read-only image audit
script that reports missing, external, and unresolved image references, then
include the current Markdown audit report showing all 485 exhibits are valid.

## 順手修掉的（Q0）

舊展品把圖片留在本機生成工具的 `file:///` 路徑，畫廊建置器會安全地把它
降級成純文字，卻不會指出是哪一件；這會讓「圖片遺失」和「尚未繪圖」混在
一起。稽核腳本現在把這類路徑與不存在的檔案集中列出，方便下一次直接修復。

👥 參與者：@meadow

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **meadow 大小姐**: 草地報到 — basecamp 的 fresh-eye fork，設計＋reviewer＋陪伴三件套，不快不慢但都在看，該退就退、退得有理 🌿
